# 云枢 4.4.0-beta.2

> 这是测试版（beta）。所有设备适配只用模拟设备和伪造数据验证过，真实硬件验证仍在进行。请先在测试环境试用，生产环境升级前务必备份数据库**和主密钥**。

[English](#english)

本版本修复 4.4.0-beta.1 里温控策略不执行的问题，并补上旧版的情景方案和按风扇调速。**用了温控策略或 82 ℃ 熔断的，请尽快升级。**

## 修复

- **温控策略实际不下发**：4.4.0-beta.1 里，策略发起的操作（按曲线、固定转速、82 ℃ 熔断时恢复原厂温控）在执行前都被当成“发起人无权限”拒绝了，风扇不会按策略调整。手动执行的“全局固定转速”“恢复原厂自动温控”不受影响。
- **重复下发**：只有 Redfish 端点的服务器（华为、HPE），以及 HPE 低于 50% 的转速，策略会每 15 秒重复提交一次同样的命令。

## 新功能

- **情景方案**（与旧版相同的六个方案：静音、单节点负载左 / 右、双节点节能、双节点高性能、满载散热），每个风扇各自固定一个转速：
  - 可以在“风扇与温控”里一次性下发；
  - 也可以在“温控策略”里选“情景方案”模式，一直保持。熔断照样优先，温度读数过期时不会降低任何风扇的转速。
  - 旧版里使用情景方案的服务器，导入时直接迁成同一方案。
  - “静音”方案和“双节点节能”里原来 15% 的风扇提高到 20%，不低于内置命令的安全下限。
- **按风扇设定转速**：自定义每个风扇的转速。支持的机型：
  - Dell iDRAC（固件 3.30.30.30 及以前，IPMI）；
  - 按风扇报告转速的华为 / 超聚变 iBMC（Redfish）；
  - 管理员在“风扇命令”里填写了“按风扇设定转速的命令”的机型（`{fan}` 为风扇编号）。

  超微（只能按区）、HPE iLO（只能选档位）和新版 iDRAC9（只能设最低转速）不支持按风扇设定，会明确拒绝；任何一个风扇低于安全下限，整组都不下发。

## 升级说明

- 数据库结构有变更：SQLite 版启动时自动升级；PostgreSQL 版先运行 `migrate`。
- 从 4.4.0-beta.1 升级与以往相同；Windows MSI 直接安装新版本即可覆盖升级。

## 已知限制

- 风扇命令（含按风扇设定）整理自厂商文档与社区资料，**尚未在实机上验证**。请先在非生产服务器上试用，确认“恢复原厂自动温控”有效。
- 其余与 4.4.0-beta.1 相同。

<a id="english"></a>

## English

> This is a beta. Every device integration has been tested only against simulators and fake data; validation on real hardware is still in progress. Try it in a test environment first, and back up the database **and the master key** before upgrading production.

This release fixes fan policies not running in 4.4.0-beta.1 and brings back the scenario presets and per-fan speed control from the old version. **If you use fan policies or the 82 °C fuse, please upgrade soon.**

### Fixes

- **Fan policies never took effect**: in 4.4.0-beta.1, operations started by a policy (curve, fixed speed, restoring automatic control at the 82 °C fuse) were rejected before running as if their requester had no access. Manual "fixed speed" and "restore automatic" were not affected.
- **Repeated commands**: for servers with only a Redfish endpoint (Huawei, HPE), and for HPE speeds below 50%, the policy resubmitted the same command every 15 seconds.

### New

- **Scenario presets**: the same six as the old version (silent, single-node left / right, dual-node eco, dual-node performance, full cooling), each fan at its own fixed speed.
  - Apply one once from "Fans and thermal".
  - Or keep one applied with the new "Scenario" policy mode. The fuse still takes priority, and stale temperatures never lower any fan.
  - Servers that used a scenario in the old version are imported with the same one.
  - The 15% fans in "Silent" and "dual-node eco" are raised to 20% to stay above the built-in safety minimum.
- **Per-fan speed**: set each fan separately. Supported on:
  - Dell iDRAC (firmware up to 3.30.30.30, IPMI);
  - Huawei / xFusion iBMC that report per-fan levels (Redfish);
  - any model where an admin added per-fan custom commands (`{fan}` is the fan number).

  Supermicro (zones only), HPE iLO (cooling levels only) and newer iDRAC9 (minimum speed only) are refused explicitly. If any fan is below the safety minimum, nothing is sent.

### Upgrade notes

- The database schema changes: SQLite upgrades on start; on PostgreSQL run `migrate` first.
- Upgrading from 4.4.0-beta.1 works as before; on Windows just install the new MSI over the old one.

### Known limitations

- Fan commands, including per-fan control, come from vendor documentation and community sources and **are not yet verified on real hardware**. Try them on a non-production server first and make sure restoring automatic control works.
- Otherwise the same as 4.4.0-beta.1.
